name: productivity
description: Portable, general-purpose productivity skills for any workflow: hand the conversation off to a new agent (handoff), get a plan stress-tested through relentless interview (grill-me), stand up a monitor outside the chat (watch), explain a problem before touching it with options and one recommendation (explain), turn the agent's own pile of findings and jargon into small plain-language decisions walked one at a time (untangle), and author a new skill that is portable, concise, in a generic voice, with a trigger-rich description (write-a-skill).

interface.shortDescription: Portable helpers: handoff, plan grilling, watchdogs, explain-before-fix, one-at-a-time decision walks, skill authoring.
